userPrompt: What public directories exist to find people?
responseText:
Here are the main **public directories** that are actually useful for finding old friends in the US and internationally (2025):

### Top Free / Low-Cost Public People Search Directories

| Directory | Best For | Notes |
|-----------|----------|-------|
| **FastPeopleSearch.com** | Current address, phone, relatives | One of the best free aggregators |
| **TruePeopleSearch.com** | Address history, phone, email | Very clean, regularly updated |
| **BeenVerified.com** | Deep background (paid after preview) | Good for older records |
| **Intelius.com** | Address history & relatives | Strong on older data |
| **PeopleFinder.com** | Basic free + paid reports | Simple interface |
| **Spokeo.com** | Social media + contact info | Decent free previews |
| **Radaris.com** | Address & neighbor info | Sometimes shows current location |
| **Whitepages.com** | Phone lookup & basic address | Free tier is limited now |
| **ZabaSearch.com** | Old-school public records | Still works for some older people |

### Other Strong Public Sources
- **Social Media**: Facebook (People search), LinkedIn, Instagram
- **State Voter Registration** (many states are public)
- **County Property Records** (if you know last city)
- **Google** with exact name + city + quotes (e.g. "John Smith" "Austin" -inurl:linkedin)
- **Newspapers & Obituaries** (via Newspapers.com or Google News)
